total_queries.description: Total number of search queries generated

bucket.description: Which tier this need belongs to (copied from Stage 1 structured)

embedding_query.description: Natural language query for vector search: concise descriptive sentences with species, lifestage, product category, and key attributes from Stage 1 description written as natural phrases

bm25_query.description: Keyword search query for lexical matching: precise boolean text with important terms from embedding_query

top_k.description: Number of results to retrieve from vector search. Varies by category: staples (3-5), supplements/treats (5-8), toys/enrichment (8-12), seasonal/niche (10-15)

rationale.description: Why this pet needs this (copied from Stage 1)

negatives.description: Allergens and safety exclusions (copied from Stage 1)
